One optional step sends text from your documents: the AI reading in the B/L and AWB draft maker, and only when you press its button. See section {0}.

In the B/L and AWB draft maker, your invoice and packing list are first read on your device. Only if you then press “Read them with AI” is the text of those documents (not the files) sent to our server and passed to Cloudflare Workers AI, which finds the shipper, consignee, ports and goods description. The text is used for that one reading and we do not store it. Cloudflare states that it does not keep this content after the request and does not use it to train AI models. If you never press the button, nothing from your documents is sent.
